title: TOPSIDE
text: The handler's call sign is TOPSIDE. Your briefing names no person behind it, no office and no chain of command: only a frequency and a schedule. A reel recovered from Listening Post 4, boxed in 1963, carries a handler checking in a crew far below. Same call sign, same phrasing, the same dry pause before the word Auger. Voice comparison aboard rates the match as complete. The comparison also notes that on every recording, old and new, TOPSIDE never draws a breath between sentences. Asked about the reel, the program office called it a training exercise.
teaser: The handler's voice is on a reel boxed in 1963.
